name: Breadcrumb
usage: Folder paths, the parent pages of a detail page, settings subpages

props.name: items
props.description:
The path from the top level to the current page; the last item is the current page and is not a link. Items
with `href` are links; items with only `onClick` are rendered as buttons; items with `menu` are buttons that open
a dropdown menu (such as sibling folders).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark; the built-in text by default ("Breadcrumb").

fields.name: title
fields.description: Text of the item.

fields.name: href
fields.description: Address the item links to.

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Called when the item is clicked. An item with `onClick` and without `href` is rendered as a button.

fields.name: menu
fields.description: A dropdown menu opened by the item, such as sibling folders; the item is then a button.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Menu items: actions and dividers (`{ type: 'divider' }`).

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Called with the key of the chosen item; the menu closes afterwards.

fields.name: selectedKeys
fields.description: Keys of the items shown as selected, such as the current option of a settings menu.

types.name: DropdownMenuItem
types.summary: An item of a Dropdown menu: an action or a divider.

types.name: DropdownMenuAction
types.summary: An action in a Dropdown menu.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Unique key, passed to the `onClick` of the menu.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Text of the item.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Icon before the text: a name, or an icon component such as Lucide's `Copy`.

fields.name: danger
fields.description: Destructive action, shown in the danger color.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: Disabled: shown but cannot be chosen.

fields.name: shortcut
fields.description:
Shortcut hint shown at the end of the item with Kbd, such as `'mod+c'`. Only a hint: register the shortcut
itself with useHotkeys.

types.name: DropdownMenuDivider
types.summary: A divider between groups of Dropdown menu items.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Marks the item as a divider.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Unique key; the position in the list by default.

types.name: IconName
types.summary:
Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`. Props that take an
icon also accept an icon component instead of a name (see IconComponent).

types.name: IconComponent
types.summary:
An icon component, such as Lucide's `Plus` (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`), accepted wherever an icon name
is: `<Button icon={Plus}>`, `<Icon icon={Plus} />`, menu items and so on. Names (`icon="plus"`) are convenient
and work in data such as menu configurations, but cover only the registered icons (`iconNames`); a component can
be any Lucide icon, or an SVG of your own. Both are drawn with the same size, stroke width and `tone`.

types.name: IconComponentProps
types.summary:
Props that Icon passes to an icon component. Lucide icons (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`) accept them; a
component of another icon set, or an SVG of your own, works too if it accepts them, or passes them on to its
`<svg>`.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Width and height in pixels.

fields.name: strokeWidth
fields.description:
Stroke width in the units of a 24 × 24 view box, already scaled for `size`: the line is 1.75 px wide on screen
by default, whatever the size.

fields.name: color
fields.description:
Stroke color: `currentColor` (the text color) or a semantic color variable, such as
`var(--vl-color-danger)`.

fields.name: aria-hidden
fields.description: `true` for a decorative icon (hidden from screen readers).

fields.name: aria-label
fields.description: Accessible name of a meaningful icon.

fields.name: role
fields.description: `img` for a meaningful icon.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: The path from the top level to the current page; the last item is the current page and is not a link.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Buttons and menus
examples.description:
Items with only `onClick` are rendered as buttons (for navigation inside the application); `menu` opens a
dropdown menu with sibling pages.
